newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Text of Czech c bank head, PM statements on crown.
newsitem.headline: Text of Czech c bank head, PM statements on crown.

text.p: Following is an unofficial translation of statements on the change to the Czech National Bank's exchange rate policy delivered by CNB Governor Josef Tosovsky and Prime Minister Vaclav Klaus on Monday.

Josef Tosovsky: "The banking board of the CNB decided today to cancel the so-called fluctuation band for the movement of the exchange rate of the crown against the basket of currencies. That means that as of tomorrow, the exchange rate policy will be changed.
"Decisive for the rate of the crown will be the relation of the crown to the mark, and so far no exact fluctation band has been set,"

"We expect that the government, in a significant way, will supplement the existing package of measures which it approved recently in a way which would contribute to a faster elimination of the external imbalances,"
Vaclav Klaus: "After a thorough consideration I decided to accept this monetary, or more precisely exchange rate, measure and to support it.
"Today the the financial market is playing against us and a fight with them would be very expensive for us,"

"It is a pity, that this process is happening -- unfortunately -- our political instability and nervousness contributed to that. Foreign capital is losing its faith in us, and we have to convince it of the opposite quickly,
"I believe that this situation will lead to a unification of the whole of our political spectrum, to a principle unification of today's government coalition and fast stabilisation of the government."

"I want to assure everybody, that we cannot abandon the macroeconomic budgetary or fiscal stability on which this government insists and will insist further. The government is prepared to make further fiscal restrictions in case there is a threat that the state budget is moving away from balance,"
"The government will seek an agreement with the opposition and social partners in order to avoid a destabilising indexation of incomes and wages, which would start turning the inflationary spiral."
"I have aready debated today with Chairman Milos Zman of the Social Democrats and with Chairman of the Czech-Moravian Chamber of Trade Unions, Richard Falbr."

"Let's seek a new balanced level of our exchange rate on the market. Let's not try to find any big danger in the movement of the exchange rate. Let's expect that it will be in the tens of hellers (cents) not crowns,"
"I am repeating that the government is prepared to supplement these central bank measures by further suitable measures."
